name: @buku/database
description: Prisma schema, migrations, seed data and the shared database client.

scripts.generate: prisma generate && prisma generate --config prisma.directory.config.ts && prisma generate --config prisma.user.config.ts && prisma generate --config prisma.business.config.ts && prisma generate --config prisma.catalog.config.ts
scripts.migrate:deploy: prisma migrate deploy && prisma migrate deploy --config prisma.directory.config.ts && prisma migrate deploy --config prisma.catalog.config.ts
